question.problem:
Find and categorize all the local extrema of the function 
$f(x,y)$ 
given that

$$
{f}^{′}(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}-y & 8{y}^{2}-x\end{aligned}].
$$

choices.value: $f(x,y)$ has local maximum at $(0,0)$ and a local minimum at $(1,\frac{1}{2})$
$f(x,y)$ has a saddle point at $(0,0)$ and a local minimum at $(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{4})$
$f(x,y)$ has a saddle point at $(0,0)$ and a local maximum at $(1,\frac{1}{2})$
$f(x,y)$ has a local maximum at $(0,0)$ and a local minimum at $(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{4})$
$f(x,y)$ has a saddle point at $(0,0)$ and a local maximum at $(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{4})$
